newsitem.title: USA: Ericsson gets $100 mln wireless order.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson gets $100 mln wireless order.

text.p: Ericsson said on Wednesday that it has a commitment from an Ohio company to buy $100 million of wireless infrastructure network equipment over the next five years.
The order from ComScape Telecommunications Inc of Columbus, Ohio, calls for Ericsson to deliver network switching equipment for ComScape's new wireless service network, Ericsson said.
Ericsson said the equipment includes its SuperCordless and AXE 10 switching equipment, radio exchange units, base stations and handsets.
Ericsson said ComScape will use the equipment for a new wireless network in Charleston, West Virginia, which is scheduled to go on line in the 1997 second quarter.
